user_idea_text: A Slack bot for freelance bookkeepers that automatically chases their clients for missing receipts and bank statements, so month-end close stops dragging into a second week
user_idea_brief: A Slack bot for freelance bookkeepers that automatically chases clients for missing receipts and bank statements to accelerate the month-end close process.
derived_market: The bookkeeping automation software market provides digital tools designed to streamline financial data collection, reconciliation, and reporting processes. It encompasses platforms and integrations that reduce manual administrative burdens for accounting professionals and their clients.

anchored_pains.pain_title: Cannot close books until clients provide source documents
quotes: The second most common complaint I've seen is that you have to spend a lot of time chasing clients for invoices/receipts/details.

I found that chasing clients for clarification over transactions & getting hold of invoices was the biggest time sink….How many times do we check what transactions are outstanding, double check you have not already been sent it - send an email to the client requesting clarification…I was repeating this every week for every client and I just knew that I wasn’t going to get anything back, or it would come in last minute, weeks after I requested it.

kill_risks.claim: The search results show direct document-request/reminder functionality in Plutio: client portals with automatic reminders, which overlaps the core chasing job (receiptrouter.app and Plutio results).

The evidence points to buyers already using bookkeeping suites, bank features, spreadsheets, Excel templates, and free tools such as Wave; none of the results establish willingness to pay for a Slack-only overlay (Bench, Wave, Reddit, LinkedIn results).

The evidence does not establish that late receipts and bank statements are commonly identified through deterministic patterns or that Slack is the modal client communication channel; it only shows a general discussion of managing incoming documents at scale (Facebook result).

evaluated_idea.value_proposition: For freelance bookkeepers, CloseCue automatically identifies late receipts and bank statements, drafts precise Slack chases, and escalates unresolved requests before month-end close.
